description: Build a checklist and step order for negotiating an early lease exit with the landlord, tailored to the break fee, months remaining, mitigation duty and local re-let demand. Use when the user wants to negotiate the fee down or plan the conversation. Do NOT use to compute costs - use estimate_break_cost.

break_fee_months.description: Break fee in months' rent stated in the lease, e.g. 2. Default 0 = no break fee

landlord_mitigates.description: Set false if the landlord claims no duty to re-let; adds a tip to get that in writing. Omit if unknown

months_remaining.description: Months left on the lease, e.g. 7; 6 or more adds a longer-runway tip. Default 0

relet_demand.description: How quickly similar units re-let locally: high, medium or low. Default medium

name: negotiation_checklist

checklist.description: Tailored negotiation points and protections, in priority order

disclaimer.description: Informational, not-legal-advice disclaimer to show with the result

order_of_operations.description: Numbered steps for running the negotiation from first ask to signed agreement

title: Negotiation checklist
